notes.title: Trading Cards, Emoticons and Profile Backgrounds incoming
notes.content:
Dear players!

We hope you had a great christmas and new years eve! 

I am happy to announce that we're done with creating the Trading Cards, Emoticons and Profile Backgrounds for Black Sails: The Ghost Ship.

Once Valve has approved the new assets, we will release them.

Happy collecting in that case!

notes.title: Version Update - Black Sails
notes.content:
We just released a patch (which will be automatically download when Steam is started - unless you have that feature turned off) which contains the following fix(es):

- Fixed a problem with the mouse cursor not being responsive at not native resolutions < 1920x1080
